reviews.title: Outstanding value
reviews.body: As a recreational, rarely competitive, swimmer I have tried multiple goggles over the years, including expensive brands and custom-made ones.These seem to be the best. As a first, with these, I don't have leaks or fogging at all.Outstanding value.I wish they had the more elegant black band without the mirrored lenses, but that's ok.
